**The fix** (the genuinely subtle part): unlike adamw/lion, neuralgrok trains an amplifier MLP whose lookahead autograd can't run in-kernel. The codebase already had the documented seam — `NeuralGrok.maybe_train_amplifier`/`train_amplifier_step` (needs host `p.grad` for the `|g|` featurization). The kernel computes its own TC-reduced grad and owns the weight update; the host backward is amplifier featurization only; `fused_train_step` scatters the freshly-trained `psi_pack()` into the kernel's `extra` slice before the launch.
